curated-gf-darker-grotesque-gf-ovo: Darker Grotesque runs tight and unvarying, its s flaring open at the ends. Ovo takes over underneath with gently shaded strokes and a tall middle band, so a long stretch of text, a dissertation abstract for instance, feels steady and grown-up.
curated-gf-delius-gf-hanken-grotesk: Friendly and personal, Delius keeps its lowercase low and its line soft. Hanken Grotesk follows with moderate height and wide channels into every counter, which gives the pair a tidy, wire-thin counterweight to all that handwriting.
curated-gf-do-hyeon-fs-erode: Do Hyeon looks packed tight, its round letters as heavy as its straight ones. Erode relaxes the mood with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight and broad openings, so paragraphs move along with a dignified, editorial ease.
curated-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-pre-gf-leagu: Edu AU VIC WA NT Pre looks like casual pen-and-paper writing, short and low-slung, while League Spartan stands taller and cleaner beside it (family reunion shirts, say). Long paragraphs would feel stiff here.
curated-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-pre-gf-tasa-: Loose, low and handwritten, like strips of marker. TASA Orbiter stands a little taller with open, unclogged counters, so the two keep a page lively yet legible (custom embroidery patches would suit the heading's cut-strip look).
curated-gf-edu-sa-hand-gf-encode-sans-sc: Graceful and casual, Edu SA Hand writes with one flat line weight and cut-back terminals (a vintage handwriting journal, maybe). Encode Sans SC sits taller beneath it, with a shallow curl and wide gaps, giving the handwriting something firm to lean on.
curated-gf-edu-tas-beginner-gf-biz-udmin: BIZ UDMincho reads bookish and traditional, with shallow curls and wide gaps. Edu TAS Beginner hugs the baseline in tight handwriting above it, and that low, personal contrast is what makes the pair memorable.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Crayon-soft and a little scruffy. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre has a faint thick-thin rhythm that suits big, short headlines, while Tsukimi Rounded keeps its round, parallel-edged letters quietly beneath.
curated-gf-elsie-instrument-sans: Fat stems, hairline threads, bowls that fill the line. Elsie belongs in big, short headings (an about us team page, say), while Instrument Sans stays pencil-thin and uniform underneath.
curated-gf-euphoria-script-fs-hoover: Relaxed script, close-fitted and hand-written. Hoover brings refined, robust strength with a generous e and compressed ascenders, and beside Euphoria Script it grounds the pair, a family recipe keepsake for instance.
